itemized.notes: 2022 cover ('2022 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate'), Type of Report: Seven days before a general election, not an amendment, signed 11/1/2022 — matches index date 2022-11-01. County Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p4) are blank stubs reading 'Seeattached'/'See Attached'; real detail is the filer's spreadsheet export: 'Donations' pp8-10 (39/41/47 rows) with p11 carrying ONLY the printed TOTAL row $36,679.44 (no data lines), 'Expenditures' p12 (18 rows, printed TOTAL 21449.91). Blank 'Summary Page - Other Campaign Accounts' and its two blank itemized pages sit at pp5-7. The donations sheet's black bar covers Address AND City AND State AND Zip columns on every row -> no geography survives. The attachment splits name into First name/Last name columns; donor_raw joins them with a single space. Two Ashley Liewer self-donation rows ($0.86, $0.10) print no date and no occupation. Row 'Campaign Account Transfer' $2,988.08 10/11/22 is a transfer line counted in the filer's total, transcribed verbatim. 'SLCO Decocratic Party' row: 'Decocratic' verbatim; its Last name cell prints the numeral '17122827'. 'Angellique Morrill' (p10) vs 'Angelique Morrill' (p9) spelling difference is verbatim on the page. Chunk-file priors confirmed at the page (c_rows 127, e_rows 18, per-page 39/41/47, bar covering city/state/zip).
